original.statement: prometheus-operator requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0 because it uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions.

decision.reason: [ev-eacfddf95197] says that prometheus-operator requires Kubernetes >= v1.16.0 because it uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 CustomResourceDefinitions. The environments exposed are clusters running a Kubernetes version below that minimum. The proposed condition, cluster-version kubernetes out-of-range ">=1.16.0", says exactly this and uses the standard form for this kind of requirement. The evidence does not show whether this requirement is new in 0.86.0 or what fails on older clusters, but neither is part of the applicability question.
